svg.text: #584 Enterprise LLM Guardrails & Prompt Shields: Zero-TTFT Parallel Speculative Safety Gateway

✓ Parallel Speculative Input + Sliding-Sentence Output Gate (+6ms Only!)

IN PARALLEL with Main LLM Prefill (240ms) → Finishes 210ms BEFORE 1st Token!

• Output Path: Stream tokens per clause + HHEM-2.1 Groundedness NLI (6ms/clause)

• Enforce Data-Instruction Spotlighting (<untrusted_data> tags) + separate Prompt Shield scan on every retrieved RAG chunk & MCP tool response.
